name: keen_front
for: Keening Cage: keen (refit of the approved pilot)
notes: The approved pilot unchanged in look, refitted: the pilot was drawn at 45 px/m (3.3 m) but side.rs draws the Keening Cage at 3.6 m (idle 135 px = 37.5 px/m), so its ~112 px front stood ~3.0 m against a 2.4 m band. Scaled 0.8 about its foot to ~88 px, reference sprite removed, canvas trimmed from 300x172 to 94x109, see-through dust/wisps made solid (pilot sheet had 94 colours, this has few). Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 98; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 87; place that point on the ring's position.
